audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to blind her Twin Fang cast, and the page never said what Miasma's grounding actually does to Vault or that Petrifying Gaze cancels Behind Enemy Lines. spikes[0] and early also referenced a 'Vulnerable proc' Quinn does not have.
audit.why: Blinding Assault hinders vision — it affects basic attacks, and Twin Fang is an ability, so blinding it does nothing. Miasma grounds: Vault is a movement ability and will not cast at all inside the cloud, which is stronger than 'you get slowed'. Petrifying Gaze stuns anyone facing her, and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, so the stun ends it.

edits.before: Passive-mark AA trades win every short exchange. Identify how Cassiopeia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Pre-Noxious Blast she is helpless: your range and Harrier auto-resets let you trade and leave before any poison exists.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Cassiopeia must walk into your range.
edits.after: Her kit completes: Miasma grounds Vault and Twin Fang melts poisoned targets — her DPS overtakes yours here.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Miasma's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She grounds your Vault with Miasma, 24s at rank 1, and out-sustains your poke with Twin Fang's heal — hold range and farm.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Miasma's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Liandry's spike out-DPSes your lethality through the blind — trade only while Miasma is down.

edits.before: Her R face-stun locks you in melee where Twin Fang bursts you — your R is roam-only and can't answer her combat ult.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns you facing her and cancels Behind Enemy Lines outright — never channel while her 120s R is up.

edits.before: You out-range her pre-Q Cassio with autos and Harrier leaps — hit Vulnerable procs before her poison ramps.
edits.after: You out-range pre-Q Cassiopeia with autos and Harrier leaps — bank the Harrier bonus before her poison ramps.

edits.before: Her R face-stun is a death sentence if it lands frontally — bait it or hold E to break LOS, and never use your R to engage her.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you are facing her, and that stun cancels Behind Enemy Lines mid-flight — never channel into her R.

edits.before: Land your Q blind on her Twin Fang cast so her sustained DPS whiffs the trade
edits.after: Save Blinding Assault for her autos — the blind does nothing to Twin Fang

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours — pre-Q Cassiopeia has no reliable poke and you out-range her with autos, so abuse Harrier: leap in on the Vulnerable proc, then E-Vault back out before she can land Noxious Blast (Q). Bait her Q poison and sidestep it; uncharged she can't sustain her HP through your trades. Stay mobile because once she has W-Miasma at level 3 she'll ground your Vault and your kite turns off.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours — pre-Q Cassiopeia has no reliable poke and you out-range her with autos, so abuse Harrier: Vault in for the marked auto, and the leap-off drops you back at your own max range before she lands Noxious Blast (Q). Bait that Q and sidestep it; uncharged she cannot sustain through your trades. Stay mobile, because Miasma at level 3 grounds Vault and your kite turns off.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Miasma grounds for 24s at rank 1 — Vault will not cast at all inside it. Petrifying Gaze's stun also cancels your R channel.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma: 24s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — grounded means Vault will not cast at all, so cross the cloud on foot. - Twin Fang: 0.75s, her whole DPS and her heal — anti-heal early. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, and its stun cancels your channel.
